from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information about one paper extracted from the document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers in the collection that this paper references; if it does not reference any provided papers, this list is empty")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated information from all provided papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
